patterns.note: Centered content blocks with alternating two-column layouts for feature sections, creating a clear visual rhythm down the page.
Prominent, bold sans-serif headings (Gilroy Bold) paired with a clean, highly legible sans-serif body text (Inter) for a modern, direct communication style.

A stark white background contrasted with deep black text, punctuated by a vibrant electric blue for calls to action and subtle, playful gradients (pinks, purples, blues) used for decorative elements like orbiting avatars.
Hero elements (central card, orbiting avatars) dynamically scale down and fade out as the user scrolls, while subsequent content sections slide up and fade into view with a staggered effect.
Feature sections are presented as distinct, self-contained blocks, each with a clear heading, descriptive text, and an illustrative image, often featuring the brand's signature checkerboard pattern.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered animations are used to create a dynamic page experience. The hero section elements scale and fade out as the user scrolls down, while subsequent content blocks (text and images) slide up from the bottom and fade in as they enter the viewport. The orbiting avatars in the hero and footer sections utilize continuous CSS keyframe animations for their rotation and color shifts. The checkerboard pattern backgrounds also animate their reveal.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful headings (Gilroy Bold) provide strong hierarchy, often several times the size of the clean, readable body text (Inter), creating a clear visual distinction.
design_tokens.radius: Consistently rounded corners on buttons, cards, and image containers, giving a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, contributing to a clean and uncluttered presentation.

standout: The site's distinctive use of the 'checkerboard' transparency pattern as a prominent design motif, integrated into product screenshots and background elements, immediately communicates its digital image manipulation focus. This, combined with the playful, gradient-filled orbiting avatars, creates a unique, almost game-like or 'metaverse' aesthetic that sets it apart from typical SaaS landing pages.
